value.text: A caller submits a cityId to Dashboard.savePlace. The handler serializes the body and sends POST /places with a 10-second abort signal; the declared OpenAPI request is an object containing only cityId, with oslo, helsinki, and lisbon as allowed values. The saved Dashboard-to-Places mapping is agent-proposed, so runtime target binding is not established. Places returns 400 UNSUPPORTED_CITY when its city mapping fails; otherwise it awaits repository.Save and returns 200. Save inserts the place in a database transaction, inserts a place.requested version 1 outbox record only when the place insert returns a new id, and commits. A conflict skips the outbox insert but still commits. Dashboard forwards a parsed upstream status/body, while a fetch or JSON parse exception returns 503 PLACES_UNAVAILABLE; the wrapper has no retry and that response does not say whether the Places transaction committed. The no-outbox path is tied to the place INSERT returning null on conflict; that can reflect an existing city or another request, so it is not a retry guarantee for the timed-out caller. The saved process links publisher and consumer views separately; an outbox row is not proof of Kafka publication or consumption.
